summary: Gives guidance to people designing new DHCPv6 options so that the formats are easy for existing DHCPv6 software to adopt. It also gives guidelines for expert reviewers who evaluate new option registrations. It updates RFC 3315.

eli5.summary: This is a how-to for adding new questions to a form that computers use to get their settings. It makes sure the new questions are written so old programs can still read the form.

questions: how to create a new dhcpv6 option
